title: Geometry-Aware Block Selection for Sparse Variational Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.28256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse variational Gaussian processes (SVGPs) are a widely used, principled approach to scalable Gaussian process modelling. Their success stems from their theoretically interpretable structure: they provide a lower bound on the marginal likelihood of the full GP while allowing scal- able stochastic optimization. Recent work has explored modifications of the posterior conditional distribution and has shown that such extensions can improve upon this well-established framework. In particular, introducing a block-diagonal structured scal- ing matrix leads to a tighter lower bound on the GP marginal likelihood. We investigate whether selecting blocks that tighten the variational objective improves test RMSE and NLL at a fixed inducing-point budget. translated_title: 面向稀疏变分高斯过程的几何感知块选择方法
translated_abstract: 稀疏变分高斯过程（SVGPs）是一种被广泛使用的、有原则的可扩展高斯过程建模方法。其成功源于其理论上可解释的结构：它们在支持可扩展的随机优化的同时，为完整高斯过程的边缘似然提供一个下界。近期的工作探索了对后验条件分布的修改，并证明此类扩展能够改进这一成熟的框架。特别是，引入块对角结构的缩放矩阵可以得到更紧的高斯过程边缘似然下界。我们研究了在固定诱导点预算下，选择能够收紧变分目标的块是否可以改善测试RMSE和NLL。由于缩放矩阵是通过完整残差协方差矩阵对数行列式的上界对变分下界做出贡献的，我们的工作做出了以下贡献……
tldr: 本文提出一种几何感知的块选择方法，通过在固定诱导点预算下选取能收紧变分下界的块对角缩放矩阵中的块，从而提升稀疏变分高斯过程的测试RMSE和NLL性能。
